title: Codex Agent Role Format
description: JSON Schema for OpenAI Codex CLI agent role configuration (TOML format, installed to ~/.codex/agents/)

model.description: Model identifier to use for this agent role

model_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the model

developer_instructions.description: System prompt / developer instructions for this agent role

sandbox_mode.description: Sandbox isolation mode: strict (no network/filesystem) or workspace (project files only)
